query.en: Design a modern wedding invitation (portrait card): serif display type for the couple's names, a muted sage-green and terracotta palette, a short ceremony/reception detail block (date, time, venue), and a simple RSVP line at the bottom. No floral clipart, no gradient background, no stock photography — decorative elements should be simple drawn linework (e.g. a thin botanical line sketch) if used at all. Use `—` placeholders for names/date/venue I haven't given you.
